name: local-web-crawler
description: Local website research, extraction and manual change monitoring through a private Firecrawl deployment.

interface.longDescription: Read and crawl websites through this Mac, with only verified local capabilities exposed. Manual monitors compare content hashes and short excerpts. No hosted agent, commercial enrichment or Cloud fallback.
defaultPrompt: Scrape this webpage into useful Markdown.
Map this site and identify its documentation pages.
Run a small bounded crawl and summarize the results.
